system.effect:
Attack with a magic spell. Attempt the appropriate check against the appropriate Defense:
❷ Quick Cast. See Spell for details, but generally: One damage die plus Precision Damage (if any); One target; No significant additional effect; No damage on Graze or Miss.
❸ Focused Cast. See Spell for details, but generally: Full damage dice plus Precision Damage (if any); use the spell’s normal effects; One damage die plus Precision Damage (if any) on Graze.
❹ Committed Cast. See Spell for details, but generally: Full damage dice plus Precision Damage (if any); additional spell effects such as expanded area.
Special A Cast of 3 or more actions gains the Prepared trait.
